feeds.title: Higher Plain Music » Neo-Classical Music
feeds.description: Higher Plain Music launched in 2008 and is an independent musical haven to discover and enjoy new music that enriches the soul. The site's mission is to share new and upcoming music as well as celebrate the music that truly leaves a lasting impression on you. In Neo-Classical Music discover new music that tingles your ears, taps your toes and enriches your soul.

feeds.title: Nagamag » Neo-Classical Music
feeds.description: Nagamag launched with an initial focus on music genres such as Neoclassical, Ambient, Chillout, Indie Electronic, many more and plans to be expanded in the near future, as good music has no borders! Discover music releases and artists around the globe. Listen to Neoclassical, Pop, Jazz, House, Electronica, Techno, Blogwave, and more!

feeds.title: Unrecorded » Neo-Classical Music
feeds.description: We are Unrecorded. A new music blog dedicated to showcasing the best-undiscovered talent around. With a healthy focus on independent artists, our writers are committed to shining a light on great music that you may not have heard yet. Find blog posts about Neo-Classical Music classical written by arunariver and HQ.

feeds.title: Music Dances When You Sleep
feeds.description: At Music Dances When You Sleep We love ambient, meditative, neoclassical music genres. Music Dances When You Sleep is a music blog covering ambient, meditation & drone music within both the classical, electronic and experimental realms. Dive into a vast expanse of wonderful audio worlds.
